title: Codex announces the final banked reset credit of the 28-day series
summary: A second banked usage-reset credit was announced at the close of the 28-day series. A redeemable credit is separate from an automatic reset of every account.

title: Verified Claude Ultra accounts begin losing the five-hour limit
summary: Max 20x is renamed Ultra. The five-hour restriction is being removed for verified Ultra subscribers; newer accounts may keep a temporary restriction. Weekly limits are unchanged.

title: Claude grants a redeemable reset and raises five-hour limits
summary: The Opus 5.5 announcement includes a 20% increase in five-hour session allowances and a reset credit for eligible plans. The credit is not an automatic reset for all accounts.

title: Claude announces a permanent 25% increase in weekly allowances
summary: Announced August 29 and effective September 14, standard weekly Claude Code allowances rise by 25% for the listed plans. This replaces the temporary 50% promotion.
